**Target class:** Week 4 — Sep 15

[Arrays, lists, loops, conditionals and sine]({{ site.baseurl }}/sessions/#b04) · Target weeks 4–5

One arrays session covers both example files: linear and nested grid repetition, hexagonal and radial arrangements, conditionals and sine. Develop the XYZ cube array before hexagonal arrays to introduce later volume sampling.
